name: DecideCommunicationLink
transaction_boundary: one LLD-01 UnitOfWork; target owner validator participates read-only and LLD09 writes only communication link/proposal/retention history
authoritative_reads: communication_proposal exact revision/fingerprint and COMM_LINK_V1 contract
guards: proposal evidence and candidate match current
receipt_order: replay -> revalidate -> insert command_receipt -> link/proposal/hold/retention events -> audit/results -> commit
revision_effects: accepted link creates revision=1 and proposal terminal state; rejection closes proposal hold and may start orphan grace; replay no duplicate link
